findings.title: Load fallback locales for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: Fallback locales are loaded only when ApplicationController#set_locale calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. The translation wrapper still loads only config.locale, and this backend explicitly disables automatic loading of translation files. Consequently, translations performed outside a controller request (for example, by a background job using a non-English locale) cannot find missing keys in the site locale or English unless those locales happen to have been loaded previously in that process. Ensure the applicable fallback locales are loaded on the translation path rather than relying on a controller filter.

findings.title: Include the fallback configuration in the translation cache identity
findings.body: The fallback chain now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the translation accelerator caches optionless translations using only the key, requested locale, and backend object ID. If a missing translation is cached from the site locale and an administrator subsequently changes the default locale, the same lookup continues returning the old locale's text because the fallback chain is never consulted on a cache hit. Include the site fallback locale in the cache key or invalidate the translation cache when the default locale changes.
